_comment: Task 52b golden replay baselines. Both missions are the exact same seed-1, 8-operator (4v4) fixture built through Sandata.Headless.HeadlessRunner.BuildOpenGrid(8) and Sandata.Headless.HeadlessRunner.BuildInitialState(8, 1, packingSide) -- the same dense, alternating-faction packing HeadlessRunnerTests and the seed-1 benchmark workload use -- ticked for 40 ticks with MissionTickPolicy.StateHashCadenceTicks=1. EmptyOrderStream submits no orders (the pure autonomous case). NonEmptyOrderStream submits, at tick 0 through SandataSimulation.SubmitOrder: a MoveAlongPath order for faction 0's entity 1 along the two-node path (4,4)->(12,4), and a Hold order for faction 1's entity 2. Both orders were accepted (no rejection). Every hash below was measured by running GoldenReplayTests.ZZZ_CaptureBaselineValues (a temporary capture test, removed once these values were recorded), never calculated or typed by hand. TickStateHashesHex[i] is SandataSimulation.LastStateHash immediately after RunTick(i), formatted X16.
